headline: AI axe falls, 1.35 lakh tech jobs gone in 10 months
claim: Companies are cutting jobs and tying the cuts to AI.
notes: published 2026-11-05 (Malayala Manorama, Business desk). Counts come from the layoffs.fyi tracker (through 2026-10-29: 135,446 tech layoffs at 334 companies, 93,217 attributed to AI). The article repeats the tracker's figures without checking them. Attribution is what companies said, not a measured effect.

headline: October Layoffs at Three-Year Low; Seasonal Hiring Plans Up 26%
claim: Companies are cutting jobs and tying the cuts to AI.
notes: published 2026-11-05; monthly job-cut report. Year to date: 121,401 announcements citing AI, about 20% of all cuts; October: 1,265 AI-cited cuts, the lowest monthly figure this year. Reasons are employer-stated; Challenger says a company citing AI does not prove the technology replaced workers. Primary source, not news coverage. AI is no longer the top stated reason.

headline: Eminem song publisher seeks $41M in copyright lawsuit vs. AI platform
claim: Training AI on copyrighted songs harms songwriters and the music industry.
notes: published 2026-11-07; syndicated from Detroit Free Press (Brian McCollum). Eight Mile Style (publisher, not Eminem) sued Suno in San Francisco federal court, seeking more than $41M for about 269-270 works. Allegations only; Suno's response not in the article.

headline: Elvis Presley rights holders and Eminem's publisher sue AI music generator Suno
claim: Training AI on copyrighted songs harms songwriters and the music industry.
notes: published 2026-11-07; author credited only as 'Pop Culture & Art', no wire credit. Covers the Eight Mile Style suit and a separate Presley-estate suit filed the same day. Article gives no damages figure. Allegations only; no court has ruled.
